title: Terms and Rules
lede: These terms set out how opetlife works, what you can expect from us and what we expect from members and partners. Please read them before you create an account, book a service, place an order or publish anything.

sections.heading: 1. About opetlife and these terms
paragraphs: opetlife is an online platform for pet families. It brings together pet records, veterinary and care bookings, a shop of independent sellers, pet-friendly travel, a pet taxi, lost-and-found pets, a community and animal-support campaigns.

The operator's legal name, registration details and address are shown in the site footer and on the Contact page. By creating an account, or by using any part of the service, you accept these terms and the Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.

Partners (clinics, care providers, sellers, hosts, drivers, insurers and charities) also accept the partner terms they sign when they join. Where a partner agreement and these terms differ on a partner matter, the partner agreement applies.

sections.heading: 2. Words we use
items: Member: anyone with an opetlife account who uses it for their own pets and household.
Partner: a verified business or person who offers services or products through opetlife, such as a vet clinic, groomer, sitter, boarding, host, seller, pet-taxi driver, insurer or charity.
Booking: a reservation of a partner's service, or a trip, made through opetlife.
Order: a purchase of products from one or more sellers in the opetlife shop.
Wallet: your opetlife credit balance, which can be used for purchases on the platform.
Content: anything a member or partner publishes or uploads, such as posts, photos, reviews, lost-pet reports and documents.

sections.heading: 3. Your account
items: You must be at least 18 to open your own account. Younger family members can take part through a household that a parent or guardian owns.
Sign-up and sign-in use your mobile number and a one-time code. Where it is available, you can also use a password or a Google account. The information you give must be accurate and your own.
One account is for one person. Do not share your codes or password. You are responsible for what happens in your account until you tell us it has been misused.
A household owner can invite family members. Every invitation needs the owner's approval, and the owner decides who can see and manage each pet.
We may limit, suspend or close an account that breaks these terms, puts animals or people at risk, or is used for fraud. Where the law and safety allow, we will tell you why and how to appeal.

sections.heading: 4. Our role
paragraphs: opetlife is an intermediary. Partners provide their own services and sell their own products, set their own prices within our rules, and are responsible for their quality, legality and description. A seller's invoice is issued in the seller's name.
We check partners before they can take bookings or sell, but a verified badge only means we reviewed the documents they gave us. It is not a guarantee of every service.

Business listings imported from open map data are labelled as unverified until the business claims and verifies them. Links to other sites, such as accommodation on Jajiga, take you to services that have their own terms. The insurance section only compares published plans: the insurer decides on applications and issues the policy, under its own terms.

Sponsored listings: partners can pay to show a listing in a separate block marked “Sponsored” at the top of some lists, such as shop searches and categories, vets and service providers. A sponsored listing is not a recommendation, a rating or a verification by opetlife. Which sponsored listings you see depends only on the list you are viewing (its own filters, such as category, species, city or type of service), never on your profile, pets or history. The rest of the list keeps its usual order.

sections.heading: 5. Partner obligations and verification
items: Partners must pass identity and business checks before they go live. We review identity documents and, for clinical services, a valid professional licence. Depending on the partner type we may also ask for a national ID card, a business licence or an e-trust (eNamad) certificate, a landline and a verified mobile number. We aim to review submitted documents within 24 working hours.
Partners must keep their documents current. We send a reminder before a document expires and may pause a partner whose documents lapse.
Listings, prices, availability, cancellation terms and product details must be true and up to date. Health data a partner receives through a booking may be used only for that booking.
Partners must follow the law, animal-welfare standards and our community rules, and must treat members' personal data as the Privacy Policy describes.
Commissions, payouts and settlements are set out in the partner agreement and the partner dashboard.
Only a verified organisation can claim an unverified business listing. A claim made in bad faith leads to removal.

Only verified organisations can run sponsored listings. They are prepaid from the organisation's business wallet at one flat price per click that opetlife sets for everyone and shows in the partner dashboard, with the date any new price applies from. Partners set a daily budget and a maximum price per click: an ad stops showing when the budget or the wallet runs out, and simply isn't shown while the price is above that maximum. At most one click per listing per day is charged for each signed-in account and for each network address; repeat clicks, clicks by the partner's own team or our staff, automated clicks and browser prefetches are free. Our staff can refund invalid clicks to the wallet and can hold or stop a campaign, and partners are told when their wallet runs out.

sections.heading: 6. Bookings and services
items: Before you book, you see the price, how and when you pay, and the partner's cancellation terms: how many hours before the appointment you can cancel for free, and the refund percentage for a later cancellation. Those terms are saved with your booking and do not change after you book.
If the partner cancels, you get a full refund. If you cancel inside the free-cancellation window, you get a full refund. A later cancellation is refunded at the percentage shown when you booked.
If you don't turn up, the partner may record a no-show, and no automatic refund is made. If the partner doesn't turn up, report it in the booking and our support team will review it.

A partner sees only the pet information its service needs. For example, groomers and walkers do not see health records, while boarding and clinical services can. This access ends 24 hours after the booking.
opetlife does not give veterinary advice. Information on the platform does not replace an examination by a vet. In an emergency, contact a vet or an emergency clinic straight away.

sections.heading: 7. Pet taxi
items: The fare shown before you request a ride is calculated from the city's published rates (base fare, distance, time, carrier size and extra pets) and is never below the minimum fare.
While online payment for rides is not available, you pay the driver when the ride arrives, as shown in the app.
You can cancel a request at any time before pickup. Your pet must travel in a suitable carrier, and the driver may refuse a ride that is unsafe for the animal.
During the ride you see the driver's position and phone number. The driver sees the pickup and drop-off. After 30 days, we keep the trip's locations only roughly, to about one kilometre.

sections.heading: 8. Shop orders, delivery and returns
items: Prices are shown in toman and include everything shown at checkout. An order is confirmed once payment is accepted.
You can cancel an order and get a full refund at any time before the seller ships it.
Delivery is by courier or post, depending on the seller and your area. The expected time and tracking are shown on your order.

If an item arrives damaged, does not match its description or has expired, report it within 48 hours of delivery from your order page. Include photos and keep the item and its packaging. If the delivery failed, you can ask for a refund from the same page. Our team reviews every request.
Approved refunds are returned to your original payment method or credited to your opetlife wallet. Your refund notice tells you which. Our finance team reviews and processes every refund.
Selling live animals is not allowed in the shop. Products must be legal, safe for animals and described honestly.
Nothing in this section limits the rights you have as a consumer under the law, including the Electronic Commerce Law and the Consumer Rights Protection Law.

sections.heading: 9. Payments, wallet and card-to-card
items: Checkout shows the ways to pay that are available for that purchase. These may include an online payment gateway, your wallet, a card-to-card transfer, or paying the partner directly.

Card-to-card: transfer the exact amount to the account shown at checkout, then upload the receipt within 30 minutes. Our finance team checks receipts during working hours: Saturday to Wednesday 9:00–18:00 and Thursday 9:00–13:00, Tehran time. A booking paid this way must start at least 24 hours later. If you paid too much, the difference is credited to your wallet. If you paid too little, you have 30 minutes to pay the rest.

The wallet has two kinds of credit. Refund credit comes back to you from cancelled or refunded purchases. Purchase credit comes from top-ups and gifts, and can only be spent on opetlife. Gift credit expires six months after it is given. The wallet does not earn interest. Both kinds can be spent on opetlife. Paying refund credit out to a bank account is not yet available in the app; if you need it, contact Support and our finance team will review your request.

Each member account and each partner organisation has its own wallet; a business wallet is seen and managed only by the organisation's wallet managers. Our staff move credit between wallets only for a recorded reason: your own request, merging your accounts, a refund, a payment sent to the wrong account, handing an account over, a legal order, or correcting a payment. Between wallets with no common owner, only refunds, wrong-account payments, account handovers and legal orders are allowed, and an organisation that is not yet verified can only receive refunds. One staff member requests each transfer with a reason and evidence, a different authorised staff member must approve it, a single transfer is at most 50,000,000 toman, the people of both wallets are notified in the app, and it is recorded in our accounts and audit log. A transfer is never edited or deleted; it can only be reversed by a new transfer approved the same way.
A top-up must be at least 10,000 toman and at most 50,000,000 toman. You can have at most three top-up requests waiting for review.
Promotions apply automatically when you are eligible and cannot be combined. Apart from the subscription gift code described below, when we offer one, there are no discount codes.

Subscriptions and free trial: some extra features are part of optional paid plans, shown with their price on the subscription page. If you have never paid for a plan, you can try one for free once: it can start when you add your first pet, or you can start it from the subscription page. Starting the trial needs no card and no payment, and it lasts the number of days shown when it starts, normally 7. Each account, household and mobile number can have only one trial; to check the number, we keep only a scrambled (hashed) form of it. We remind you in the app, and by SMS where available, two days before it ends. When it ends, you simply go back to the free plan: we never charge you without your explicit consent. You can end the trial early, but it still counts as used.

Subscription gift code: when we offer one, it is shown on the subscription page. It works only on your first paid subscription purchase, including after a free trial, and can be used once per account and household. It can't be combined with other promotions or exchanged for cash or wallet credit. You see the discounted price before you pay, and a code with an end date stops working after that day.
Instalment payments, when offered, are provided by a third-party financing company under its own terms and approval.

sections.heading: 10. Community, lost and found pets, memorials
items: Be kind and truthful. Abuse, harassment, threats, scams, spam, animal cruelty, selling animals, and publishing other people's personal information are not allowed.
Posts appear straight away. Anyone can report a post, and we review reports. We may warn, restrict, suspend, or remove content or accounts that break these rules. You can appeal a decision.
A lost-pet report must be about your own pet or one you are responsible for, and must be true. Publish only an approximate area, never your home address. Found-pet posts are limited to three a day.
Area alerts tell members nearby about a lost pet. Your own location stays private and is rounded to about one kilometre.

A memorial page is published only with the owner's consent and after review. The owner can withdraw it at any time, which removes it from opetlife pages straight away. The original photo stays in your pet's memories until you delete it there; copies others have saved or that remain in search engines are outside our control. On request, our team deletes the stored image files within 30 days.

sections.heading: 11. Reviews
items: You can review a product only after it has been delivered to you, and a partner only after a completed booking. Reviews are checked before they appear.
Reviews must describe your own experience. Paid, swapped or fake reviews, and reviews written to harm a competitor, are removed.

sections.heading: 12. Your content and our brand
paragraphs: You keep the rights to what you publish. You give opetlife a free, non-exclusive licence to host, show and adapt it, for example to resize photos, so that we can run the service. That licence ends when you delete the content, except where others have already shared it or the law requires us to keep it.
Only publish content you have the right to share. The opetlife name, logo and design belong to the operator. Third-party media we use is credited on the Credits page.

sections.heading: 13. Things you must not do
items: Use opetlife for anything illegal, or to deceive members or partners.
Get around security or limits, probe for weaknesses without permission, or interfere with the service.
Collect data from the site with automated tools without our written permission.
Open several accounts to misuse promotions, reviews or limits.
Take payments for a booking or order outside opetlife in order to avoid our rules or fees.
Click sponsored listings repeatedly or with automated tools, for example to use up a competitor's budget.

sections.heading: 14. Responsibility and liability
paragraphs: We work to keep opetlife available, accurate and secure, but we cannot promise it will always be uninterrupted or error-free. Partners are responsible for the services and products they provide.

To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for a partner's acts or omissions, or for losses caused by events outside our reasonable control. Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot be limited by law.

sections.heading: 15. Closing your account
paragraphs: You can ask to delete your account from Profile → Privacy. You can't delete it while you have upcoming bookings, open orders, refunds or disputes, an active trip, a partner role, or a shared household of which you are the only owner. You can cancel a deletion request while it is under review. What happens to your data is explained in the Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: 16. Support, complaints and disputes
items: Contact us through Support or the Contact page. We aim to give a first answer within 24 working hours.
For a problem with a booking or order, open a request from that booking or order. We will hear both sides and decide on a refund or other remedy.
If we cannot resolve a complaint, you can take it to the competent authorities and courts of the Islamic Republic of Iran.

sections.heading: 17. Changes to these terms
paragraphs: Changes take effect when we publish them here. For important changes, we also show a notice on the site and email you if your account has an email address. The date at the top of this page shows the latest version. If you keep using opetlife after a change, the new terms apply.

sections.heading: 18. Governing law
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the laws of the Islamic Republic of Iran, including the Electronic Commerce Law and the Consumer Rights Protection Law.

sections.heading: 19. Contact
paragraphs: For questions about these terms, use Support or the Contact page. Our contact details are shown on the Contact page and in the site footer.
